title: Mesh split runs the coverage gate only after separating every component
body:
## Summary
A shattered mesh pays for a full LOOSE separate before being refused.

## Description
The refusal needs only per-component face counts, which a fixed-width union-find gives before any object is created. Today one Blender object per speck is built first; the recorded crate had 451 components and the 2026-08-18 crash input had 1600+.

## Flow
- Import -> join -> count components -> refuse or separate

## Expected impact
A refused split costs a count, not N objects.

## Evaluation
Claim: Moving the gate ahead of separate bounds memory on the inputs that are refused anyway.
Before: unmeasured: no RSS or time taken on a high-component input
After: peak RSS flat in component count on the refused path
Method: simulation
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence: scripts/visual-gen/pof_mesh_split.py:161 separates all loose parts before scripts/visual-gen/pof_mesh_split.py:199 can refuse a shattered mesh
instrument: Real Blender 4.2 probe on a synthetic 20k-component GLB: peak RSS and wall time, current order vs a pre-separate union-find count (the loose_shell_count shape from pof_mesh_finish.py)

title: QuadriFlow prep builds full-density BMeshes with no ceiling, unlike the interior cull
body:
## Summary
Two paths build the same whole-mesh BMesh; only one is bounded.

## Description
The file refuses the cull above 200k faces because it cannot cap a whole-mesh BMesh, then enters edit mode and calls bm.from_mesh on the same 1.5M-face input for QuadriFlow. A BMesh scales with the mesh, so this may be acceptable; nobody has the number.

## Flow
- quad_retopo -> prepare_for_quadriflow -> edit mode + nonmanifold_edge_count

## Expected impact
Either a measured ceiling with a fallback marker, or a recorded measurement that none is needed.

## Evaluation
Claim: The quadriflow path has the same unbounded allocation the cull refuses.
Before: unmeasured
After: measured RSS curve; ceiling only if it earns one
Method: simulation
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence: scripts/visual-gen/pof_mesh_finish.py:244 and scripts/visual-gen/pof_mesh_finish.py:268 run on the undecimated copy; CULL_FACE_CEILING at scripts/visual-gen/pof_mesh_finish.py:42 only guards the cull
instrument: Real Blender 4.2 peak RSS for --retopo quadriflow at 200k, 800k and 1.5M faces, to decide whether a ceiling is warranted and where

title: Smart-low-poly arena can lose critique output and grade an error page
body:
## Summary
A paid arena run can report a false critique failure or score an error body.

## Description
runLocalProcess was written to wait for close because exit can precede the last output; this copy resolves on exit. downloadToBase64 base64-encodes whatever came back and sends it to the Qwen judge as the render.

## Flow
- Paid Tripo task -> critique spawn -> parse; render download -> Qwen

## Expected impact
The arena result stops depending on a stdio race and a non-OK render is reported as such.

## Evaluation
Claim: Waiting for close and checking res.ok removes both false readings.
Before: not measured: the file runs main() on import, so no case could be driven without extracting it
After: test over the extracted seam
Method: simulation
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence: scripts/visual-gen/pof_tripo_smartlowpoly_arena.ts:68 resolves on exit, before stdio drains; scripts/visual-gen/pof_tripo_smartlowpoly_arena.ts:98 reads the body without checking the status
instrument: Extract the spawn and download into an importable module, then a test with a child that writes after exit and a stub 403; or adopt runLocalProcess from src/lib/visual-gen/local-process.ts. src/lib/visual-gen/mesh-critique.ts:254 carries the same exit-based copy and belongs to another context

title: Animate CLI cannot collect a retarget it already paid for
body:
## Summary
A retarget that outlives the poll window or fails its download must be bought again.

## Description
The model CLI gained resume so a paid task is never re-bought; this chain has --rig-task for the rig but nothing for the final step. The task id is printed, but no flag accepts it.

## Flow
- prerigcheck -> rig -> retarget -> poll -> download

## Expected impact
A timeout or failed download is recoverable with the printed flags.

## Evaluation
Claim: Parity with pof_tripo.mjs saves one paid retarget per recoverable failure.
Before: no failure frequency recorded
After: stub cases green; POF_TRIPO_RESUME printed
Method: simulation
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence: scripts/visual-gen/pof_tripo_animate.mjs:74 throws on timeout and scripts/visual-gen/pof_tripo_animate.mjs:164 stops on a failed download; there is no --anim-task flag, while src/lib/visual-gen/tripo-cli.ts prints POF_TRIPO_RESUME
instrument: Fetch-stub cases over src/__tests__/scripts/visualGenCliHarness.ts: anim poll window spent and download 500, then resume with --anim-task issuing 0 POST

title: pof_txt2img.py has no importer in the app: keep as a CLI or retire
body:
## Summary
A local SDXL front with no caller in the app.

## Description
No runner spawns it, it is absent from SCRIPT_MARKERS, and it hardcodes cuda with no fallback. It may still be a deliberate operator tool, which the tree cannot tell.

## Flow
- Operator runs it by hand, or nobody does

## Expected impact
One fewer unowned generator, or a recorded reason to keep it.

## Evaluation
Claim: The script is reachable only by hand.
Before: 0 spawn sites in src/
After: owner call
Method: probe
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction
evidence: scripts/visual-gen/pof_txt2img.py:1; a grep of src/ for pof_txt2img finds no spawn site
instrument: Owner decision: is local SDXL still a supported 2D front now that Leonardo, Qwen and Codex images cover it
